observations: Black game console with a glossy top surface.
One black DualShock 4 controller is resting on the console.
The console has a horizontal design with a visible disc slot on the front.
The console is sitting on a tiled floor with various cables around it.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BOLA.O' across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console model is visible in photo 0, but there is no photo showing the console powered on or a homebrew menu.
The storage capacity is not visible in the photo.
No games are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the console connected to a PSN account showing online status.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be smaller than claimed (e.g., 500GB instead of 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen in the system menu.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or third-party unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number and serial number on the rear of the console.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the model number and serial number on the back of the console.
Photo of the 'Storage' settings screen showing the total capacity.
Video of the console booting up and navigating the home menu.
Photo of the controller's buttons and sticks being tested.
Photo of the games mentioned in the description.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
